snippet.title: Inkblood - Official Developer Overview | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Developer Overview for Inkblood, a 2D mystery adventure game developed by Hey Bird! Players will become wrapped up in a narrative filled with an investigation, ritual murders, and the need to uncover hidden connections. Inkblood is coming soon to PC (Steam).
